description: A shell script for testing various 'push.default' settings in Git, including setup of remotes, push behaviors, and workflow scenarios.

methods.name: check_pushed_commit
methods.description: Checks that the latest commit in a local revision matches the remote revision.

methods.name: test_push_success
methods.description: Tests that a push with a specified push.default value succeeds and the expected commit is pushed.

methods.name: test_push_failure
methods.description: Tests that a push with a specified push.default value fails and no remote branches are modified.

methods.name: test_pushdefault_workflow
methods.description: Tests push behavior under different workflows and push.default settings, including success and failure scenarios.
